observations: Photo shows a boxed/packed multifunction copier/printer unit on a table.
Brand text on the box reads 'FRANCOSODETOIA' (appears like packaging/label text; not clearly a copier brand/model).
No clear view of the control panel, model number, serial label, ports, or any output/copy test page.

claims.evidence: Only a packed unit is visible; no readable model/specs to confirm multifunction type or cost class.
Photos show packaging; cleanliness of internal parts/rollers cannot be verified.
No copy/print sample or test page shown.
No counter reading (machine display or service menu) shown.

claims.claim: New drum and toner just fitted, no paper jam.
claims.evidence: No photo of drum/toner installation, no maintenance label, and no jam-free test shown.

risks.risk: Unknown exact model/specs (speed, toner type, drum compatibility) which drives Lagos pricing and parts availability.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the machine’s model/brand label (rear or inside door) and the control panel showing model name.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown multifunction copier with uncertain parts/toner availability (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Page count claim may be inaccurate; high wear can mean soon-to-fail rollers/fuser/transfer belt.
risks.proof: Photo of the machine counter/page counter screen (or service menu) showing total pages.

risks.risk: “New drum and toner” may be unverified; could be used/incorrect consumables causing poor quality or short life.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the drum/toner labels (part numbers) and a receipt/box label if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not confirmed new consumables (assume normal wear).

risks.risk: No paper jam claim not proven; could jam due to feed rollers, pickup assembly, or misalignment.
risks.proof: Video/clip of a full print/copy run (e.g., 20–50 pages) showing no jams and consistent feeding.
risks.if_unproven: Price as may jam / not fully proven (worst-case: treat as needs troubleshooting).

risks.risk: Copy quality claim not proven; could have streaks, banding, or ghosting.
risks.proof: A test copy/print photo (text + a photo page) taken from the machine, not from packaging.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed sharp output (worst-case: assume quality issues until tested).

proof_requests: Clear photos of the copier’s brand/model label and serial number (rear/inside door).
Photo of the page counter/total pages from the machine display or service menu.
Close-up photos of the installed drum and toner (part numbers/labels).
Video clip of a successful copy/print run (multiple pages) showing no paper jam.
Photo of a test copy/print showing sharp text and no streaks/banding.
response.reason: The photo does not show the copier’s model/identity or any counter/test evidence, so a worst-case price cannot be set confidently from remote information.
